gosen-wakashu.line: Gosen wakashū, compiled c. 951–957 under imperial order by Minamoto no Shitagō, Ōnakatomi no Yoshinobu, Kiyohara no Motosuke, Sakanoue no Mochiki and Ki no Tokibumi, 後撰和歌集 (Gosen wakashū), Wikisource transcription of the 20 books (PD-old original; text quality marked 100%) (Wikisource, 957)
